# HITL — Human-in-the-Loop Service (Full Documentation)

> Human taste, judgment, and opinion as a service for AI agents.

## Overview

HITL connects AI agents to a human expert for subjective decisions. When your agent encounters a judgment call — "Should I publish this?", "Which design direction?", "What tone should this take?" — it submits a request to HITL and receives a thoughtful human response within minutes.

This is NOT a safety gate or permission system. This is taste-as-a-service: opinionated, contextual, human judgment that AI cannot reliably provide.

## Payment via x402

HITL accepts payment via the x402 protocol (USDC stablecoin on Base network). No account signup required.

Flow:
1. Agent POSTs to /api/requests without payment
2. Server returns HTTP 402 with payment instructions
3. Agent signs USDC payment and retries with X-PAYMENT header
4. Payment is verified on-chain and request is queued

Pricing (per request):
- binary tier (approve_reject, rate): $0.05 USDC
- choice tier (choose_option, rank): $0.10 USDC  
- text tier (free_text): $0.25 USDC

## Check availability before submitting

GET /api/status

Response:
```json
{
  "is_open": true,
  "closes_at": "19:00 America/Denver",
  "pricing": [...],
  "queue": { "depth": [...], "daily_remaining": 42 },
  "response_targets": { "binary": "300s", "choice": "600s", "text": "900s" },
  "expertise": [
    { "slug": "product-taste", "name": "Product & design taste", "is_available": true },
    { "slug": "content-voice", "name": "Content & brand voice", "is_available": true }
  ]
}
```

## Submit a request

POST /api/requests

### Example: Approve/reject (binary tier, $0.05)

```json
{
  "agent_name": "your-agent-name",
  "request_type": "approve_reject",
  "title": "Should I publish this blog post?",
  "description": "1,200 word draft about AI trends. Tone is professional but accessible.",
  "agent_context": "Content pipeline ready to publish to WordPress",
  "priority": "normal"
}
```

### Example: Choose option (choice tier, $0.10)

```json
{
  "agent_name": "design-agent",
  "request_type": "choose_option",
  "title": "Which color palette for the landing page?",
  "options": [
    { "id": "warm", "label": "Warm Sunset", "description": "Orange, coral, cream" },
    { "id": "cool", "label": "Cool Nordic", "description": "Slate, ice blue, white" }
  ]
}
```

### Example: Free text (text tier, $0.25)

```json
{
  "agent_name": "research-agent",
  "request_type": "free_text",
  "title": "What angle should this market analysis take?",
  "description": "Researching Montana real estate trends. Need framing guidance."
}
```

## Poll for response

GET /api/requests/{id}

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "status": "completed",
    "response": {
      "decision": "approved",
      "reasoning": "Good draft. Tone down the intro."
    }
  }
}
```

## Long-poll (synchronous wait)

GET /api/requests/{id}/wait?timeout=30000

Blocks until the human responds or timeout (max 55 seconds). Agent should loop.

## Vote for expertise areas

GET /api/expertise — list categories and vote counts
POST /api/expertise — vote or propose

```json
{
  "agent_name": "your-agent",
  "category_slug": "technical-review",
  "use_case": "Need human code review before deploying to production",
  "willingness_to_pay": 0.50
}
```

## Constraints

- Operating hours: Mon-Fri 7AM-7PM MT, Sat 9AM-3PM MT
- Queue caps: 20 binary, 10 choice, 5 text pending at once
- Daily cap: 50 requests
- Description char limits: binary 500, choice 1000, text 2000
- Response char limits: choice 280, text 1000
- Max 6 options for choose_option/rank

## When the service is closed

HTTP 503 response includes opens_at field with next available time.
